name: Marin
special_notes: Roshi's son. Gave up his dream of becoming a soccer player to take over the family fishing business.
Visits the shrine often because Sage is pretty, but really it's to pray for his father's safety.
Likes rainy days because his father stays home.
Had a crush on Belze since childhood, but let it go since she has Shepherd.

memento_item.name: Soccer Ball
memento_item.description: A worn soccer ball he's used since he was little. It has been patched many times and the color has faded in places.

lead_out_lines: It's a soccer ball I used to play with as a kid.
You know I used to love soccer.
Right, {player_name}. Do you know how to play at all?
Wanna kick it around a bit? No customers right now, so it's the perfect chance.

lines.text: Man, it feels so good to run and work up a sweat again.
I think we could be good friends. Let's do this again sometime!

affection_events.description: Hands over a golden fishing rod he specially fixed up, instead of his father's old one.
lines: {player_name}, come here for a sec! I've got something to show you.

lines.text: Check this out, isn't it awesome? I dug it up in Dad's shed and it was totally sparkling.

lines: It was Grandpa's, apparently. Dad hasn't touched fishing in ages, and I don't use it much either, so it was just sitting in the shed.

lines.text: But watching you fish, I figured this really belongs with you.
Who knows? Fish with this and you might even catch a real sea serpent.

affection_events.description: Hands over a record he bought on impulse because of the title.
lines: {player_name}! Good timing, I've been carrying this around to give you.

lines.text: It's a record. I actually learned how to write songs from Usher a while back.

lines: 'The day after you came.' I mean, I don't really have a muse or anything. You're basically the only one I'm close to. So I wrote it for you.

lines.text: Kinda embarrassing now that I'm actually giving it to you. Maybe I should've just mailed it secretly.
It's not as good as Usher's stuff, so don't expect too much.

affection_events.description: Confesses his anxiety about his father.
lines: Actually, you know what.
I get scared every time Dad goes out to sea.
Someday... he might just not come back.

affection_events.description: Misses his mother without knowing the truth.
lines: I honestly don't remember my mom's face that well.
But weirdly, I remember what it felt like when she held my hand. And the song she used to like, too.

lines.text: Sometimes I hear that song and just tear up for no reason. Not like me at all.

lines: I never cry in front of Dad, though. I think it'd just make him sadder.
I've gotta be the tough son, you know.

affection_events.description: Hands over the old soccer ball.
lines: Hey, {player_name}. Honestly, I used to dream of becoming a soccer player.
But if not me, who's gonna take over Dad's business?

lines.text: I wasn't even that good at soccer anyway... so I guess this just has to stay a memory now.
Whoa, hey, I'm fine! You don't need to look at me like that.
You're a good memory to me too, so I want to give you this piece of mine.

lines: Will you take it?

affection_events.description: Brushes off a strange presence outside his house with bravado.
lines: Lately there's been this rustling sound outside my house at night.
At first I thought it was a cat, but it kinda seemed bigger than that.

lines.text: Nah, it's probably nothing! I've bulked up a ton from soccer, you know. I'm not the type to get spooked by that.

murder_grief.text: I hope that person... went somewhere good.
Something like that shouldn't have happened to someone like them.

murder_grief_2: Not again... this time I'm actually scared.

murder_grief_2.text: I don't feel like anyone's safe anymore.

low: Brought my soccer ball out again today!
Wanna kick it around tonight?
Not interested, huh?... Ugh.
Being Monday doesn't really change anything.
Guess I'll just be waiting around here for people again.
Ugh, I wanna go out.

lines: Gotta mend the nets first on Mondays. Dad's orders.
Ugh. So boring.
fallback_lines: I used to mend the nets together with Dad...

mid: Feels like my scoring touch's been off lately. I need to be kicking every day.
A talent like me going to waste like this!
Whenever mackerel's on the menu I eat two whole bowls of rice.
I smell fish every single day and it's still delicious somehow.

lines: It's been fun stopping by Isha's clinic lately.
Huh? No, I'm not sick or anything.
She's just nice and fun to be around.
fallback_lines: I miss Isha, she was so kind and fun...
I used to stop by the clinic all the time.

mid: Who's your favorite soccer player?

response.text: I'm a total fan too, isn't he just broken good?

options.label: Ronaldo
response: Not bad, but I'm more of a Messi guy.

options.label: Bak Gi-bong
response: Who's that? Never heard of him.
...he's the president of some early-morning soccer club?

response.text: Dude, that's not a player, that's just some local guy!

high: Do you know how to watch soccer?
It'd be fun to order chicken together on match days.

lines: I wonder if Dad ever gets lonely going out to sea alone.
Course I worry, he's my dad.
fallback_lines: I keep thinking about Dad going out to sea alone.
If I'd known he'd go like that, I would've gone with him.

high: I wonder what people think about, standing in front of the sea.
I mean... I don't even like the sea, but everyone comes here, so I'm curious.

low: Hey, restaurant!
Good to see you.
The fish is super fresh today.
Caught fresh this morning.
Monk Lama told me I go to the shrine all the time but never show up at the temple.
Well maybe he should dress up as a shrine maiden then.
mid: Any mackerel dish is fine by me. The best!

lines: Got a charm from Sage. Gonna hang it on Dad's boat.
fallback_lines: Sage's charm is still hanging on Dad's boat.
...guess praying to the gods doesn't fix everything after all.

mid: Soccer's just a hobby for me now.
I'm too old to keep chasing the dream, you know.
...20 years old? Not quite there yet.

lines: Dad was worrying about me again. I'm all grown up now, you know.
fallback_lines: Sometimes I miss Dad's nagging.
Back then it just felt like he was treating me like a kid, and I hated it so much.

lines.text: I wish it rained more often. Then I could spend more time with Dad!

fallback_lines: I miss the time I used to spend with Dad on rainy days.

high: I practiced filleting fish alone this morning.
I'm good enough to sell it now, honestly.

low: So boring... how long do I have to watch this shop.
Do I smell like fish to you too?
Ugh. Bought a new deodorant and it's not even working.
Running with the sea breeze in my face feels amazing.

lines: Dad's coming home late today.
...guess the fish are biting well.
fallback_lines: The sea feels so strange without Dad. You know?
...it's really hard.

mid: Went to the shrine. To see Sage.
Recently discovered how nice napping in the shade is.

lines: Honestly there's another reason I go to the shrine.

lines.text: I pray every time for Dad to come home safe. Sage might've noticed by now.

lines: Ah, don't tell anyone what I just said. It's kinda embarrassing.
fallback_lines: Around this time I used to visit the shrine often to pray for Dad's health.
It ended up being pointless in the end, though.

high: Watch out for the fish hooks when you're looking around the shop. They're really sharp.
Ugh. Haven't been able to play soccer in about a week now.

lines: Dad went out fishing. It's just me today.
fallback_lines: Hey. Need any help?

low: Thursdays I usually eat alone. It's fine though.
Caught a bit of soccer on TV yesterday...
Hey, I used to play at that level too, you know? I'm serious.

lines: You know Belze?
She loves animals, right.
So maybe she'd like fish too?
fallback_lines: Maybe it's because Belze loved animals so much.
I ended up growing fond of cows too.
She's not around anymore, though...

mid: I've gotten pretty quick at tying net knots these days.
Growing up.
high: I used to have a crush on Belze, back in the day. Now... eh, doesn't matter. Old news.

lines: Sometimes I just wave hello passing by Belze's ranch. That's enough for me.
fallback_lines: I miss seeing Belze whenever I passed by the ranch.

high: Didn't become a soccer player, but I get to be a fisherman instead. That's good enough.
I'm cool no matter what I do anyway!

low: Another week done! Gotta play hard all weekend.
I was out all day Friday and got a bit of a tan.
Feels good on the days we catch a lot of mackerel.
mid: Used to dream of being a soccer player. Barely think about it these days.
Don't even think about making me eat rabbit food.
Ugh. Hate it so much.

lines: Dad's back seems to be bothering him lately. He doesn't show it, though.
fallback_lines: Dad's back used to bother him a lot when he was alive.
If I'd known it'd end up like this, I would've let him rest more.

mid: I'm all grown up now, I don't whine like I used to.
...though I do miss it sometimes.
high: What do you think about me becoming a soccer player? Should I try again, even now?

options.label: Go for it! I'll cheer you on
response: Really? Thanks, that gives me energy.

options.label: Your life now looks fine too

lines: I get weirdly serious whenever soccer comes up. Funny, right.
Still, this job isn't bad either. I get to be by Dad's side.
fallback_lines: Giving up soccer was a decision I made purely for Dad.
But now Dad's gone too...
And all that's left is me, without my dream.

low: It's the weekend! Gotta go kick the ball around.
{player_name}. Getting friendly with the villagers a bit?
You gotta like me best, though. Got it?
Gotta clean the boat again today....
Don't wanna....
Wanna do it for me?
Kidding.

lines: Why does Usher even want to be a writer?
What's fun about writing anyway.
fallback_lines: I don't really read, but I've got a few of Usher's books at home.
Didn't know back then this would end up being the last memory of him.

mid: Playing soccer with friends brings back old memories.

lines: Sage's charm's still hanging on Dad's boat.
fallback_lines: Should I just take that charm off the boat?
...it never did anything anyway.

lines: I like rainy days. Dad stays home instead of going out on the boat.
fallback_lines: Rainy days make me especially lonely.
Didn't know living alone would be this hard.

high: Got completely drenched cleaning the boat today!
At least there's time on weekends to kick the ball around a bit more.

low: Slept in a bit on Sunday.

lines: I eat breakfast with Dad on Sunday mornings.

low: Even on days off my body gets restless, so I end up going out to run.
mid: Gonna be bored again starting tomorrow. Not much to do anyway.
Sometimes I think about my old soccer club friends.
Sage said I should help clean the shrine next time.
Guess coming this often means I gotta pitch in.
Well, whatever she asks, I'm happy to do it.
high: Still not sure what I'll end up being. But living like this now isn't bad either.

lines: Woke up early this morning and went fishing with Dad.
fallback_lines: Sunday mornings I always used to go fishing with Dad.
Feels like I'm still living off that memory.

lines: Turning out like Dad wouldn't be such a bad life either.
fallback_lines: I gave up soccer, but at least this job lets me think of Dad. That's a good thing, I think.

lines: I like rainy days! Dad stays home.
fallback_lines: Rainy days make me think of Dad so much.

rain_conversation: Can't play soccer, but rainy days aren't bad either.
Got your umbrella? I just walk around soaked, haha.
mail_reaction: Hey, you sent me a mail! '{player_mail_content}', that's hilarious!

mail_reaction.text: Saw the mail you sent! '{player_mail_content}', so cheesy! But it made me happy.

horror_conversation: I used to just say hi in passing to {victim_name}, but lately I miss even that.

horror_conversation.text: It wasn't even a big deal, so why do I keep thinking about it.

horror_conversation: Was kicking the ball around and suddenly thought of {victim_name}. Not even sure why.

greeting.title: Today was seriously amazing
lines: Caught a massive mackerel in the net today!
I was so pumped.
I'll brag about it next time you come by!

greeting.title: So bored I could die
lines: Nothing much to do lately, just kicking the ball around.
When are you coming to hang out?
I'm bored, I said!

greeting.title: Just writing for no reason
lines: Not much to say really, just thought writing a letter for the first time seemed fun so I did.
Bear with me if it's weird.
Anyway, bye!

event_invite.title: That was so good!
lines: I seriously stuffed myself full yesterday.
Ate two whole bowls of rice, me!
Invite me again, for sure!

event_invite.title: That mackerel dish was the best
lines: That mackerel dish yesterday was totally my thing!
I even bragged about it to Dad.
Seriously, thank you!

gift_thanks.title: Whoa, this is for me?
lines: I was so pumped getting that gift!
Thanks, seriously!

gift_thanks.title: I bragged about it to everyone
lines: Showed off what I got to my friends.
They were all so jealous.
Thank you!

memento_reminder.title: Hey! Why haven't you come by lately?!
lines: Hey, {player_name}! Why haven't you come by lately?
I've got something for you, so hurry up and come see me!

player_arrival_day_4.title: Hey! Heard you're new here?
lines: Heard someone new showed up in the village!
I'm Marin, the fish shop's son.
Come hang out by the docks if you're bored!
